subagent: Subagent 2: Patient Deduplication, Merging & Fuzzy Search Inquisitor

findings.fuzzy_search: Levenshtein distance (1 typo for short words, 2 typos for long words), strict defense for short surnames (Ли, Ким, Пак, Цой, Хан, Али <= 3 chars without typos), token-sort permutations, score ranking, and visual highlight chunks implemented.
findings.transliteration_and_layout: Transliteration of digraphs/trigraphs (shch, yo, zh, ch, sh, yu, ya, ts, tc, kh, etc.) and keyboard mistype conversion (QWERTY <-> JCUKEN) implemented for both search and duplicate detection.
findings.e164_normalization: National 10-digit and E.164 normalization (+7, 8, no prefix, last 4 digits) implemented.
findings.non_destructive_merge: Kopeck-exact integer addition for deposit and family balances, strict UNION for allergies and somatic safety flags without data loss, relinking of visits/images/treatment plans, duplicate marked as archived with mergedIntoPatientId for 152-FZ audit log.
findings.modal_ergonomics: PatientWorkspaceModals equipped with PatientDuplicateMergeModal, listening to dente-open-duplicate-merge-modal, 1-click execution, side-by-side comparison, zero nested card matryoshkas, desktop density.
findings.backend_routes: POST /api/patients/:patientId/merge registered in apps/api/src/routes/patients.ts; findPatientDuplicate enhanced with transliteration and layout mistype tolerance.
